headline: Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia HQ to cheering staff
dek: According to CNBC and TechCrunch, employees chanted the CEO's name across three floors.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: Back at headquarters
body: Jensen Huang was greeted by cheering, clapping employees, according to videos shared with CNBC Technology and TechCrunch AI.
He thanked them for the "second chance" and said he would be "a better CEO" (CNBC Technology).

s3.label: How it works
s3.title: Support inside and out
s3.body: The petition for his return grew large.

points.t: Topped 200,000 signatures, per TechCrunch AI and The Verge AI.
One insider cites excitement and frustration among staff (CNBC Technology).
A former employee called the reversal embarrassing (CNBC Technology).

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: The OpenAI parallel
body: ZDNet AI and SiliconANGLE compared it to Sam Altman's 2023 return to OpenAI.
Both say boards struggle to replace founders at AI companies.

items.t: Recovered about $1 trillion in value on Monday (CNBC Technology).
The Nasdaq had slid 10% the week before (CNBC Technology, Wired AI).
Harvey Jones remains chair (Mobile Time, The Verge AI).

caption.hook: Jensen Huang returned to Nvidia HQ to a cheering welcome.
body: According to videos shared with CNBC and TechCrunch, employees cheered, clapped and chanted Jensen Huang's name across three floors of Nvidia's headquarters. He thanked them for the "second chance" and promised to be a better CEO (CNBC Technology).

The petition for his return topped 200,000 signatures (TechCrunch AI, The Verge AI). ZDNet AI and SiliconANGLE compared the episode to Sam Altman's return to OpenAI. Shares recovered about $1 trillion in value on Monday, after the Nasdaq slid 10% the week before (CNBC Technology).
